facts.fact: The 2019 Canadian federal election was scheduled to take place on or before October 21, 2019.
facts.quote: the 2019 Canadian federal election scheduled to take place on or before October 21, 2019.

facts.fact: StackAdapt is the first Canadian ad tech provider to support DAAC's Political Ads Program (vendor claim).
facts.quote: StackAdapt is the first Canadian ad tech provider to support DAAC’s Political Ads Program.

facts.fact: The DAAC Political Ads Program is open to political parties, independent candidates, associations and third parties registered with Elections Canada.
facts.quote: The program is open to political parties, independent candidates, associations and third parties registered with Elections Canada.

facts.fact: Participating advertisers receive a DAAC icon license that remains active for four years, or until the next federal election is called.
facts.quote: Participating advertisers receive an icon license from the DAAC, which remains active for four years, or until the next federal election is called.

facts.fact: Information required under the Elections Act appears in an overlay box when people hover over ads bearing the DAAC 'Political Ads / Pub politique' icon.
facts.quote: When people hover their mouse over ads with DAAC’s purple “Political Ads / Pub politique” wordmark/icon, the information required under the Elections Act will appear in an overlay box.

facts.fact: The DAAC Political Ads program registration is open at PoliticalAds.ca.
facts.quote: The DAAC program is open for registration at[PoliticalAds.ca](https://politicalads.ca/).

facts.fact: DAAC's main program, YourAdChoices.ca, places a blue triangle in the corner of ads that can be clicked to see who posted the ad and allows people to opt out of specific ads.
facts.quote: provides a blue triangle in the corner of ads that can be clicked or tapped to see who posted the ad and enables people to opt out of receiving a specific type or series of ads.
